scope: Visible bodyHtml only. The plain lesson fallback and assessment banks are unchanged.

changes.contentLocation: bodyHtml > table[Common objections] > tbody > tr:nth-child(1) > td:first-child
changes.originalText: I already use AI every day, why would I need this.
changes.revisedText: I already use AI every day. Why would I need this?
changes.readabilityIssue: A comma splice and statement punctuation obscured the objection's two-part question.

changes.contentLocation: bodyHtml > table[Common objections] > tbody > tr:nth-child(2) > td:first-child
changes.originalText: Is this just another prompt course.
changes.revisedText: Is this just another prompt course?
changes.readabilityIssue: A direct question ended with a full stop.

changes.contentLocation: bodyHtml > table[Common objections] > tbody > tr:nth-child(3) > td:first-child
changes.originalText: Can you guarantee I pass.
changes.revisedText: Can you guarantee I pass?
changes.readabilityIssue: A direct question ended with a full stop.

changes.contentLocation: bodyHtml > table[Common objections] > tbody > tr:nth-child(4) > td:first-child
changes.originalText: Is this an accredited degree.
changes.revisedText: Is this an accredited degree?
changes.readabilityIssue: A direct question ended with a full stop.

changes.contentLocation: bodyHtml > table[Common objections] > tbody > tr:nth-child(5) > td:first-child
changes.originalText: Will this get me a better job.
changes.revisedText: Will this get me a better job?
changes.readabilityIssue: A direct question ended with a full stop.

changes.originalText: Keep that one sentence at the center of everything here, because the rest is detail that flows from it.
changes.revisedText: Keep that one sentence at the center of everything here, because the rest of the module follows from it.
changes.readabilityIssue: The metaphor “detail that flows from it” was less direct than naming the module.

changes.originalText: Read it once fully before your first conversation, then keep it as reference.
changes.revisedText: Read it once fully before your first conversation, then keep it as a reference.
changes.readabilityIssue: The countable noun “reference” required an article in this use.

changes.originalText: A professional will judge your judgment by how you describe the product.
changes.revisedText: A professional will assess your judgment by how you describe the product.
changes.readabilityIssue: The repeated phrase “judge your judgment” sounded awkward without adding precision.

changes.contentLocation: bodyHtml > h3[The clean product definition] + p
changes.originalText: That is the product: selective in who it takes, and guided in how it takes them through.
changes.revisedText: That is the product: selective about who is accepted and guided in how participants move through the program.
changes.readabilityIssue: Both uses of “takes” had an unclear subject and object.

changes.originalText: knowing the universal map cold
changes.revisedText: knowing the universal map thoroughly
changes.readabilityIssue: The idiom “know something cold” may be unfamiliar to international readers.

changes.contentLocation: bodyHtml > h3[One journey in full] + p:first
changes.originalText: To make it a journey, follow one real kind of person through it, week by week. Meet three: Amir, a radiologist with fourteen years in practice; Leila, an in house lawyer at a logistics company; and David, an HR director at a regional bank.
changes.revisedText: To make it a journey, follow three professionals through it, week by week: Amir, a radiologist with fourteen years in practice; Leila, an in-house lawyer at a logistics company; and David, an HR director at a regional bank.
changes.readabilityIssue: The text said to follow one person immediately before introducing three people.

changes.originalText: Finance, marketing, education, product, engineering, healthcare operations, consulting: each one is the same method wearing the prospect's own clothes.
changes.revisedText: In finance, marketing, education, product, engineering, healthcare operations, and consulting, the same method is adapted to the prospect's field.
changes.readabilityIssue: The clothing metaphor was less direct than stating that the method is adapted to the field.

changes.originalText: Check it before you describe where someone is, because it lets you speak from the record rather than rounding up.
changes.revisedText: Check it before you describe someone's status, because it lets you use the recorded status rather than overstate it.
changes.readabilityIssue: “Where someone is” and “rounding up” were idiomatic and less precise than the recorded status.

changes.contentLocation: bodyHtml > h3[Start with the person] + p
changes.originalText: Open with one question: what is the biggest challenge you are facing right now around AI in your work.
changes.revisedText: Open with one question: What is the biggest challenge you are facing right now around AI in your work?
changes.readabilityIssue: The quoted question lacked capitalization and question punctuation.

changes.originalText: Talking to a doctor, walk them through the radiologist's twelve weeks. A lawyer, the legal counsel's. An engineer, the civil engineer's.
changes.revisedText: When talking to a doctor, walk them through the radiologist's twelve weeks. For a lawyer, use the legal counsel's story. For an engineer, use the civil engineer's story.
changes.readabilityIssue: Two sentence fragments depended on an implied verb and object.

changes.originalText: The website facilities you can point to
changes.revisedText: The website resources you can point to
changes.readabilityIssue: “Facilities” is not natural English for pages, applications, and online tools.

changes.originalText: The website carries facilities you can walk a prospect through or send them to
changes.revisedText: The website provides resources you can walk a prospect through or send them to
changes.readabilityIssue: “Carries facilities” was not natural English for website resources.

changes.originalText: The program multiplies a method onto real expertise, and ten times zero is still zero, so a prospect with no real field to work from is not a hard sell, they are a poor fit you decline.
changes.revisedText: The program multiplies a method onto real expertise. Ten times zero is still zero. A prospect with no real field to work from is not a hard sell; they are a poor fit you decline.
changes.readabilityIssue: A comma splice joined three independent ideas and made the lead harder to follow aloud.

changes.originalText: A strong fit is an experienced professional with real depth in their field, who already uses AI in some form and feels the gap between using it and leading it, who has one real problem worth solving, who can commit focused hours over twelve weeks, and who wants reviewed, defensible work they can show.
changes.revisedText: A strong fit is an experienced professional with real depth in their field. They already use AI in some form and feel the gap between using it and leading it. They have one real problem worth solving, can commit focused hours over twelve weeks, and want reviewed, defensible work they can show.
changes.readabilityIssue: Four nested relative clauses obscured the fit criteria.

changes.originalText: On top of those four, every message must still use approved messaging and pass the truth test from the identity module: is it true, can you back it up, does it avoid promising what you cannot control, does it route money and data correctly.
changes.revisedText: Every message must also use approved messaging and pass the truth test from the identity module. Ask four questions. Is it true? Can you back it up? Does it avoid promising what you cannot control? Does it route money and data correctly?
changes.readabilityIssue: Four operational checks were buried inside one sentence instead of being presented as questions.

changes.contentLocation: bodyHtml > h2[How to sell it honestly] + p
changes.originalText: If there is nothing real to build on, there is nothing for the method to work with, so the program is not for them, and your job in the conversation is to find that out, not to paper over it.
changes.revisedText: If there is nothing real to build on, there is nothing for the method to work with. The program is not for them, and your job in the conversation is to find that out, not to paper over it.
changes.readabilityIssue: The condition, conclusion, and partner action were joined into one long chain.

changes.originalText: This module is the practical mechanics: how you run your work through the Partner Panel, what your first ninety days actually look like, how you keep accounts alive, and how to get help when you need it.
changes.revisedText: This module covers the practical mechanics. It explains how you run your work through the Partner Panel, what your first ninety days actually look like, how you keep accounts alive, and how to get help when you need it.
changes.readabilityIssue: The abstract phrase “is the practical mechanics” introduced a long list less directly than an instructional sentence.

changes.originalText: A serious professional will ask practical questions about the twelve weeks, and a vague answer costs you the sale while a made up one costs you more when it turns out to be wrong. Where the journey module shows the twelve weeks through a specific person's eyes, this module is the fixed mechanics and the operational answers a serious buyer will test you on: the structure you state with confidence, and the operational details you take from the current official source rather than inventing.
changes.revisedText: A serious professional will ask practical questions about the twelve weeks. A vague answer costs you the sale. A made up answer costs you more when it turns out to be wrong. The journey module shows the twelve weeks through a specific person's eyes. This module gives you the fixed mechanics and the operational answers a serious buyer will test you on. It separates the structure you state with confidence from the operational details you take from the current official source rather than inventing.
changes.readabilityIssue: Two dense sentences carried six separate ideas and were difficult to read naturally aloud.

changes.contentLocation: bodyHtml > h3[The shape that never changes] + p:last
changes.originalText: There is no week that is just watching: every week has a defined focus, a piece of work to create, and a milestone badge that marks it done, and at the end of each phase the participant earns the phase rank.
changes.revisedText: There is no week that is just watching. Every week has a defined focus, a piece of work to create, and a milestone badge that marks it done. At the end of each phase, the participant earns the phase rank.
changes.readabilityIssue: The weekly rhythm and phase outcome were joined into one long sentence.
